report.value: The IIN_HOST code sets the nominal limit in 50 mA steps with 10 mOhm, and the maximum is the nominal plus 100 mA. 0x3A00H gives 2800 to 3000 mA, 0x1C00H 1300 to 1500 mA and 0x0800H 300 to 500 mA. The BQ25713 reaches the same ranges at 0x3C00H, 0x1E00H and 0x0A00H, so the two parts are not firmware-identical. Reset limit 3.25 A. 2S VSYS_MIN resets to 6.6 V against the BQ25713's 6.144 V. The watchdog resets to 175 s and 01b is 4 to 7 s, as on the BQ25713

SCD1 steps of 11.1 mV from 22.2 mV (RSNS = 0), offset +/-2.5 mV and scale +/-5 % post-trim. With 2 mOhm, the 55.5 mV step trips at 25.2 to 30.5 A (27.75 A nominal). With 1 mOhm, the 33.3 mV step reaches 37.6 A at the tolerance limit, over 35 A, and the 22.2 mV step is 18.7 to 26.9 A. Computed

Internal bypass up to 10 mA. External mode balances one cell at a time. The TRM gives a balancing duty cycle of 75 % typical; P3 had reported it as not stated. 43 mA average at 75 % needs 57.3 mA while on, so at most 62.8 Ohm in the bypass path at 3.6 V (computed).
